decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing had its own page in both years and is a base component of the compatible product families, so the investment in tooling and the visible commitment favor keeping it.
Floor-level shower drainage sits at the core of the firm's announced low-profile, accessible direction, and its rising visibility in 2019 makes dropping it unjustifiable.
Although the designer drain lost its own page in 2019, it supports the firm's design-quality positioning, so management would attribute the weaker presence to temporary causes and persist with it.
The shower element with integrated slope fits the integrated, renovation-oriented strategy, and its modest exposure still reflects a commitment management would want to justify.
Featuring the backflow-protected basement drain on the home page in 2019 shows strong public commitment and a central role, which makes keeping it very likely.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral and only mentioned on the website, but it costs little to maintain and complements drainage system sales, so the firm keeps it.
